pattern_explanation: Each of these Portuguese words looks almost identical to an English word because both languages inherited many terms from Latin. Over time the meanings drifted apart, so the shared spelling hides a different meaning in each case.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word that looks like 'sensible' means 'sensitive', the one that looks like 'eventual' means 'occasional', the one that looks like 'assist' means 'to watch', and the one that looks like 'pretend' means 'to intend', so matching by spelling will give wrong answers.
